title: feat(chat): add top level components and templates
body:
**Summary**
This PR adds top level component/template props to the chat widget that are then forwarded to their respective ui components. Support for replacing the entire `ChatHeader` and `ChatPrompt` component has also been added.

TODO:
- Remove props that would never get passed to custom header or prompt components (I believe these would be the element attributes)
- Add support for toggle button components/layouts (can be done once some translations for it are added)
